expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The device home indicator (horizontal gesture bar) is drawn across the middle of the bottom tab bar, overlapping the search and bookmarks icons. This makes the navigation bar look visually broken and can interfere with tapping those tabs.

The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red badge dot with no numeric count or label, which may be unclear to screen-reader users and offers no information about what the notification is.
